dataset_attrs.title: ERA5 Hourly Global Reanalysis - chunked for temporal analysis
dataset_attrs.summary: ERA5 is the fifth generation ECMWF atmospheric reanalysis of the global climate covering the period from January 1940 to the present. ERA5 provides hourly estimates of a large number of atmospheric, land and oceanic climate variables at 0.25° resolution. Data are served here as an Analysis-Ready Cloud-Optimized (ARCO) Zarr store, updated daily. Recent timesteps carry expver=0005 (ERA5T, near-realtime, ~5 days behind real time) and are overwritten with expver=0001 (final ERA5) approximately two months after the reference month.
dataset_attrs.keywords: ERA5, reanalysis, atmosphere, climate, ECMWF, Copernicus, single
dataset_attrs.source: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis downloaded via Copernicus Climate Data Store (CDS) dataset reanalysis-era5-single-levels
dataset_attrs.institution: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts
dataset_attrs.acknowledgement: Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information (ERA5). Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use that may be made of the Copernicus information or data it contains.
